title: staging drain does not remove articles-table row on pipeline failure — permanent retention leak
description: In main.rs staging drain loop (line ~1128): on pipeline failure (run_pipeline_and_notify returns false), the staged article is left in transit_staging for retry. However if run_pipeline succeeded at the IPFS write step (step 1) but failed at a later step (articles-table insert), the CID is written to IPFS but has no articles-table row. The staging row will be retried, run_pipeline will write a second IPFS block, and the first block remains orphaned forever with no GC path. Design invariant 5: every article in IPFS must be pinned or under GC policy.
